title: Team Convention Catalogue (config.yml `teams:` section)
description: Delta to config.schema.json: a new OPTIONAL top-level `teams` key in the committed team config. One reviewable entry per team (SC-006). Credential-shaped values are refused without echoing (FR-018). Presented as JSON Schema; the on-disk file is YAML. Additionally, this feature makes `projects[].style` OPTIONAL in config.schema.json (style is detected at ceremony time; a committed value is an operator declaration validated against discovery).

id.description: Team identifier, unique across the catalogue. Referenced by the personal file's `team` key (FR-011).

project.description: The team's Jira project key. Target of automatic ticket creation (FR-013) and of the cross-team ticket check (FR-014).

folder_prefix.description: Folder-safe prefix, unique across the catalogue, trailing hyphen required. Placed after the numbering component in the flat feature-folder name (FR-015), e.g. specs/003-ijt-invoice-export. Combined with the existing routing rules it routes the team's features to the team's project (US3 scenario 6).

branch_pattern.description: Branch-name pattern. MUST contain <ID> exactly once and <FEATURE_NAME> exactly once; every other character MUST be in [a-z0-9/_-] (FR-010, FR-018). <ID> = the Jira ticket number stripped of its project-key prefix. '/' creates git branch hierarchy only — the spec folder always stays flat (FR-015).
